output.source_text: In bar 14 of 'I Fall In Love Too Easily', D7 has melody note D (the root). Voice D13(sus4) using D-G-C-E-G-B-D (inner voices expanding outward) then resolve to D7(b9,#11) (D-F#-C-Eb-Ab-D) before resolving to G7.

note_vi: Bài 15 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 07:08-07:43. In bar 14 of 'I Fall In Love Too Easily', D7 has melody note D (the root). Voice D13(sus4) using D-G-C-E-G-B-D (inner voices expanding outward) then resolve to D7(b9,#11) (D-F#-C-Eb-Ab-D) before resolving to G7. Nguồn giảng bằng tiếng Anh, câu trên giữ nguyên lời giảng.
